name: FeatherLight
teaser:
Wanna feel like a chad and carry 1000 rounds, maybe keep a few spare sausages in your kit?
Well now you can!
description_html:
FeatherLight is a mod for SPT that makes multiple categories of items weightless, enhancing your gameplay experience by reducing encumbrance and allowing for greater mobility and agility in raids.

Features

  • Weightless Items
    Multiple categories of items are set to zero weight.
  • Improved MobilityMove faster and carry more without the burden of weight.**
  • Customizable
    Easily adjust which categories of items are weightless.

Usage**

After Installing the FeatherLight mod, the following categories of items will be weightless by default:

  • Ammo
  • Throwables (Grenades)
  • Food
  • Drink
  • Medical Supplies

**Customization

**To customize which categories of items are weightless:

  1. Open the “config.jsonc” file located in the mod’s directory.
  2. Edit the configuration to include or exclude categories as needed.
  3. Save your changes and restart SPT for the changes to take effect.

**Compatibility

**FeatherLightis compatible with the latest version of SPT and works seamlessly with most other mods.

  • Supports: 3.9.0-3.9.x

Enjoy a lighter, faster SPT experience with FeatherLight!**
